description:
bw 0.13.0 → 0.13.1 is available.

## What's new

## 0.13.1 — 2026-05-30

- **No more `ref moved` errors under concurrent use** — commands that change issue state (`start`, `create`, `update`, `delete`, `reopen`, `attach`, `label`, `comment`, `defer`, `undefer`, `dep add`/`remove`) used to die with an error like:

  ```
  error: commit failed: ref moved: ref refs/heads/beadwork (expected f2105ed3, got 3e642ee7)
  ```

  This happened whenever something else moved the beadwork branch mid-command — another `bw` in a second terminal, a background `bw sync`, or an agent working in a worktree. Only `bw close` knew how to recover; every other command lost its work and made you retry by hand. Now all mutating commands automatically refresh against the latest state and retry (up to 12 attempts, with exponential backoff and jitter so colliding writers spread out), so the command just succeeds instead of erroring. Also fixed a latent snapshot-tracking bug in the underlying store that could spuriously trigger the same error.

## To upgrade

Run `bw upgrade --yes` or `bw upgrade` for interactive mode.

comments.text: UPGRADE ATTEMPT 2026-06-04: 'bw upgrade --yes' DOWNLOADED 0.13.1 (5.2MB, extracted OK) but FAILED the final in-place swap with 'Access is denied' on rename C:\Users\denso\bin\bw.exe — the classic Windows 'cannot overwrite a running executable' lock. Rolled back cleanly; still on 0.13.0 (staged temp file removed, nothing half-broken). Root: on a Stoa machine bw is ALWAYS in use (sessions + polling crons + agents hold the binary), so 'bw upgrade' self-replace cannot win the lock. FIX = manual swap when bw is quiescent: close other Claude/project sessions + bw-using terminals, download beadwork_0.13.1_windows_amd64.zip from the bw releases page, extract bw.exe, back up the old binary (cf. the existing bw-v0.12.3-release.exe already in C:\Users\denso\bin\), overwrite, verify 'bw --version' = 0.13.1. NOTE FOR HANDOFF: a Windows tester upgrading bw will hit this same lock — worth a one-line note in the tester runbook ('upgrade bw with all sessions closed, or do a manual swap'). Ticket stays OPEN until the swap lands.
